CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ua_private.locate_student_access(p_digest text)
 RETURNS TABLE(person_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'ua_private'
AS $function$ BEGIN
  IF NOT COALESCE(length(p_digest)=64 AND p_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$',false)
    OR current_setting('ua.phase',true) IS DISTINCT FROM 'auth'
    OR current_setting('ua.person_id',true) IS DISTINCT FROM ''
    OR current_setting('ua.person_ids',true) IS DISTINCT FROM '[]'
    OR current_setting('ua.clerk_issuer',true) IS DISTINCT FROM ''
    OR current_setting('ua.clerk_subject',true) IS DISTINCT FROM ''
    OR current_setting('ua.telegram_id',true) IS DISTINCT FROM '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_ACCESS_LOCATOR_SCOPE' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  -- Hint only, INCLUDING expired/superseded/revoked relationships. Current
  -- authorization happens under person locks in the trusted application.
  RETURN QUERY SELECT f.person_id FROM ua_private.student_access a
    JOIN ua_private.student_families f ON f.id=a.family_id WHERE a.digest=p_digest;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ua_private.lock_people(p_person_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'ua_private'
AS $function$ BEGIN
  IF p_person_ids IS NULL OR cardinality(p_person_ids)=0 OR array_ndims(p_person_ids)<>1
    OR array_position(p_person_ids,NULL) IS NOT NULL
    OR p_person_ids IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT v.pid FROM unnest(p_person_ids) AS v(pid) ORDER BY v.pid)
    OR current_setting('ua.phase',true) IS DISTINCT FROM 'auth'
    OR current_setting('ua.telegram_id',true) IS DISTINCT FROM ''
    OR current_setting('ua.person_id',true) IS NULL
    OR current_setting('ua.person_ids',true) IS NULL
    OR current_setting('ua.clerk_issuer',true) IS NULL OR current_setting('ua.clerk_subject',true) IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_PERSON_LOCK_SCOPE' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  IF current_setting('ua.person_ids',true)::jsonb IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p_person_ids)
    OR current_setting('ua.person_id',true) IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN cardinality(p_person_ids)=1 THEN p_person_ids[1]::text ELSE '' END)
    OR NOT ((current_setting('ua.clerk_issuer',true)='' AND current_setting('ua.clerk_subject',true)='')
      OR (current_setting('ua.clerk_issuer',true) ~ '^https://[^/[:space:]]+$' AND current_setting('ua.clerk_subject',true) ~ '^user_[A-Za-z0-9]+$'
        AND current_setting('ua.clerk_subject',true) !~ '[[:space:]]')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_PERSON_LOCK_SCOPE' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  RETURN QUERY SELECT p.id FROM ua_private.people p WHERE p.id=ANY(p_person_ids) ORDER BY p.id FOR UPDATE OF p;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ua_private.lock_clerk_identity(p_issuer text, p_subject text)
 RETURNS TABLE(person_id uuid, enabled boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'ua_private'
AS $function$ BEGIN
  IF NOT COALESCE(p_issuer ~ '^https://[^/[:space:]]+$' AND p_subject ~ '^user_[A-Za-z0-9]+$' AND p_subject !~ '[[:space:]]',false)
    OR current_setting('ua.phase',true) IS DISTINCT FROM 'auth'
    OR current_setting('ua.person_id',true) IS DISTINCT FROM '' OR current_setting('ua.person_ids',true) IS DISTINCT FROM '[]'
    OR current_setting('ua.clerk_issuer',true) COLLATE "C" IS DISTINCT FROM p_issuer COLLATE "C"
    OR current_setting('ua.clerk_subject',true) COLLATE "C" IS DISTINCT FROM p_subject COLLATE "C"
    OR current_setting('ua.telegram_id',true) IS DISTINCT FROM '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_CLERK_LOCK_SCOPE' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  -- Disabled mappings are returned, not hidden as absent. No create/reassignment.
  RETURN QUERY SELECT c.person_id,c.enabled FROM ua_private.clerk_identities c
    WHERE c.issuer=p_issuer COLLATE "C" AND c.subject=p_subject COLLATE "C" FOR UPDATE OF c;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ua_private.guard_history()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'ua_private'
AS $function$
DECLARE b jsonb := to_jsonb(OLD); n jsonb := to_jsonb(NEW);
BEGIN
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME IN ('ordinary_results','command_receipts','staff_receipts','staff_audit',
      'clerk_exchange_replays','init_data_replays','clerk_family_bindings','statistical_bonuses','attempt_cancellations','assignments') THEN
    IF n IS DISTINCT FROM b THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable history: %',TG_TABLE_NAME USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='student_access' THEN
    IF (n-'superseded') IS DISTINCT FROM (b-'superseded') OR (OLD.superseded AND NOT NEW.superseded) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable access binding' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='student_refresh' THEN
    IF (n-'consumed') IS DISTINCT FROM (b-'consumed') OR (OLD.consumed AND NOT NEW.consumed) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable refresh binding' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='student_families' THEN
    IF (n-ARRAY['revoked_at_ms','logout_retain_until_ms']) IS DISTINCT FROM (b-ARRAY['revoked_at_ms','logout_retain_until_ms'])
       OR (OLD.revoked_at_ms IS NOT NULL AND n IS DISTINCT FROM b)
       OR (OLD.revoked_at_ms IS NULL AND NEW.revoked_at_ms IS NULL AND NEW.logout_retain_until_ms IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.logout_retain_until_ms) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable family origin/expiry/first revocation' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='clerk_student_sessions' THEN
    IF (n-'retired_at_ms') IS DISTINCT FROM (b-'retired_at_ms') OR (OLD.retired_at_ms IS NOT NULL AND NEW.retired_at_ms IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.retired_at_ms) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable provider session/first retirement' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='test_versions' THEN
    IF NEW.id<>OLD.id OR NEW.demo_id<>OLD.demo_id OR NEW.revision<>OLD.revision+1 OR OLD.status<>'draft' OR (OLD.published_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND OLD.published_snapshot<>'null'::jsonb) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'frozen version/revision' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='attempts' THEN
    IF (n-ARRAY['body','state_revision']) IS DISTINCT FROM (b-ARRAY['body','state_revision'])
      OR (NEW.body-ARRAY['status','completedAt','stateRevision','seriesStateRevision']) IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.body-ARRAY['status','completedAt','stateRevision','seriesStateRevision'])
      OR NEW.state_revision<>OLD.state_revision+1
      OR (NEW.body->>'seriesStateRevision')::bigint<>(OLD.body->>'seriesStateRevision')::bigint+1
      OR OLD.body->>'status'<>'in_progress' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable attempt/history or invalid revision' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='exam_series' THEN
    IF NEW.person_id<>OLD.person_id OR NEW.demo_id<>OLD.demo_id OR NEW.id<>OLD.id
      OR (OLD.normal_attempt_used AND NOT NEW.normal_attempt_used) OR NEW.generation<OLD.generation OR NEW.state_revision<OLD.state_revision THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable series identity/global normal usage' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='answers' THEN
    IF NEW.attempt_id<>OLD.attempt_id OR NEW.question_id<>OLD.question_id OR NEW.revision<>OLD.revision+1 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable answer identity or invalid CAS revision' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ua_private.locate_telegram_return(p_telegram_id bigint, p_issuer text)
 RETURNS TABLE(person_id uuid, person_enabled boolean, issuer text, subject text, identity_enabled boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'ua_private'
AS $function$ BEGIN
 IF NOT COALESCE(p_telegram_id>0 AND p_telegram_id<=9007199254740991,false)
   OR NOT COALESCE(p_issuer ~ '^https://[^/[:space:]]+$',false)
   OR current_setting('ua.phase',true) IS DISTINCT FROM 'auth'
   OR current_setting('ua.person_id',true) IS DISTINCT FROM ''
   OR current_setting('ua.person_ids',true) IS DISTINCT FROM '[]'
   OR current_setting('ua.clerk_issuer',true) IS DISTINCT FROM ''
   OR current_setting('ua.clerk_subject',true) IS DISTINCT FROM ''
   OR current_setting('ua.telegram_id',true) IS DISTINCT FROM '' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_TELEGRAM_LOCATOR_SCOPE' USING ERRCODE='42501';
 END IF;
 -- Hint only, bounded at two rows so ambiguity is explicit. Disabled mappings
 -- remain visible and are never treated as a missing identity. No SID is guessed
 -- or returned here; current family/fence selection follows the ordered locks.
 RETURN QUERY SELECT p.id,p.enabled,i.issuer,i.subject,i.enabled
   FROM ua_private.people p LEFT JOIN ua_private.clerk_identities i ON i.person_id=p.id AND i.issuer=p_issuer
   WHERE p.telegram_id=p_telegram_id ORDER BY p.id,i.subject LIMIT 2;
END $function$
